videoDetails.title: WHY ARE YOU TYPING
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Learn why dictating to AI agents is a game-changer for productivity. In this video, discover how voice input lets you brain-dump your thoughts faster than typing, letting the agent handle messy transcripts and extract meaning. Find out which tools to use and how this simple shift can massively speed up your workflow.
